environmentNotes: A Tauri/Cargo process from D:\wenjian\Desktop\个人知识库 was still active during the implementation check.
Per workstation GPU and concurrency protection rules, this work package did not start a second Cargo build while that process remained active.
The existing debug executable plus the current Vite frontend was used for conservative Tauri balanced-window checks without starting a competing Cargo build.

The four-layer post-comparison material passed build and static audits, but its final Tauri visual recheck stopped when the foreground switched to another user application; post-refinement runtime visual acceptance remains unverified.

The first four-layer mid-scale contour implementation visually regressed into broad marble/camouflage bands; it was replaced by fwidth-controlled screen-space filaments with gated coverage, lower exposure and a more legible 1.018x limb shell.

The latest user screenshot confirmed that the remaining Fresnel SphereGeometry shell still represented a three-dimensional shell instead of the reference image's projected circular boundary; the shell was replaced by a camera-facing derivative-controlled silhouette ring while retaining the true sphere body and displaced corona.

A subsequent screenshot measured the first planar ring approximately 3px to the right of the visible sphere center and 3-13px inside the actual outline; the center-plane radius approximation was replaced by a per-fragment camera-ray sphere-tangent discriminant that accounts for close perspective and off-axis framing.
Cross-hotspot retargeting, five-cycle stability, 160/200/240px comparison and user visual acceptance remain required before product PASS.
